scope: One existing or API/native-V3-loaded saved area ROI, explicitly targeted as Edit Saved Area, edited through scientific XY handles and numeric geometry. This is a candidate handoff, not a packet adoption, implementation, runtime result, eligibility decision or family closure.
source_identity_policy: Pins identify the inspected product-source preimage, not a future build freeze. Revalidate changed consumed seams at adoption; unrelated new Auto wiring does not itself require recapturing unchanged selection math.

source_facts.fact: SelectionEditor already stages immutable move, eight local-axis box resizes, rotation, vertices, numeric box geometry and properties. It has no owner/controller publication policy. Mask bounds, movement and rotation scan owned selection bits, not image samples.
Roi has name, selection, optional zero-based t/c/z and attributes. There is no durable ROI UUID field. Roi equality includes geometry, position and attributes.

Manager membership captures owner plus Metadata revision and row indices; Metadata changes invalidate selection/range anchors. Existing update_roi refocuses a row after its metadata edit. These scoped row/widget identities are not persistent IDs.
Native positioned mask resolution and desktop saved-ROI visibility test each optional coordinate by presence, so explicit zero is constrained and nullopt is wildcard.

Changing rois advances both Metadata and Selection in document_changes. Metadata edits create one undo entry, clear redo and advance dirty data identity. Selection-only commits do not create pixel/metadata history. set_rois does not replace the global current or previous selection.

DocumentTransaction::select captures previous_selection once. The current ordinary editor commits the global active selection; its properties panel matches Data revisions but not a positioned row/TCZ/activation. edit_selection currently disables orthogonal viewing. Scientific generic edit/ROI actions remain guarded.

The linked renderer intentionally paints saved/current selection annotations only in XY; it does not project XY ROIs into XZ/YZ. Native V3 preserves optional ROI positions, packed masks and complete attributes; reopening creates fresh owners and does not rebind action records.

proposed_user_exit.entry: Focus one saved area row and invoke an explicit Edit Saved Area action. Show the owner, row name/index and position constraints as the edit target; do not lift the broad scientific edit guard or silently select a different row.
proposed_user_exit.position_resolution: For explicit t/c/z, navigate that axis to the exact zero-based value; wildcard axes retain their current value. Navigation is a separately observable Display effect completed before the edit capture. Editing never changes the saved row position fields.
proposed_user_exit.geometry_source: Construct SelectionEditor from that captured row selection, not from the global current selection. Reuse the same adapter for ordinary XY and the XY pane in linked viewing. XZ/YZ are read-only for this consumer.
proposed_user_exit.completion: Pointer release with a valid changed draft, or numeric Apply, accepts one saved-row geometry replacement. Escape, panel Cancel, invalidated capture or invalid draft discards the entire private draft; releasing afterward cannot resurrect a last valid preview.

token_fields: retained native owner identity and numeric document_id
identity_and_reselection.token_lifetime: Private, transient target identity; never serialize a pointer, widget ID or invented durable UUID. Reorder/delete/load/replace of the ROI collection, owner replacement/close, or any Metadata revision invalidates it.
identity_and_reselection.success: After the atomic write, refocus exactly the accepted index under the fresh owner/Metadata revision and verify complete accepted row equality. Clear prior multiselection/range anchors. This reselection is manager focus only; it does not call select() or make a second document edit.
identity_and_reselection.undo_redo: Invalidate old target/draft immediately; rebuild row focus against the restored collection. Preserve the same index only when present and the expected complete restored row is known; otherwise clear focus and require explicit reselection. Never reuse a stale index against a reordered row.
identity_and_reselection.new_owner: Reopen has a new native owner. Clear live edit targets. Stored commands retain old IDs and require explicit full rebind.

geometry_contract_proposal.admission: Saved area kinds rectangle, ellipse, rotated_rectangle, rotated_ellipse, polygon, freehand and mask; validated against the source XY extent. Dataset/sample policy is borrowed and unchanged; geometry editing needs no image-plane acquisition.
geometry_contract_proposal.boxes: Move by interior hit; Resize indices NW,N,NE,E,SE,S,SW,W using SelectionEditor local frame; Rotate handle offset24 logical GUI pixels with calibrated XY screen metric. Numeric center/size/angle use box_geometry. Keep existing Shift aspect, Ctrl center and Shift15-degree rotation behavior; these are edit modifiers, not P05l creation Boolean modifiers.
geometry_contract_proposal.vertices: Polygon/freehand expose vertex handles, whole-shape move/rotate, numeric vertex coordinates, Alt segment insertion and Delete of a focused vertex above the native three-vertex minimum. Reuse metric-aware insertion and existing Shift axis-constrained movement; do not add spline fitting.
geometry_contract_proposal.masks: A packed holed mask exposes interior Move and the existing Rotate handle; numeric translation/rotation are allowed. No resize or vertex handles are invented for masks. Movement uses the existing nearest inverse sample floor(x-dx+.5); rotation uses source-cell-center inverse sampling and floor. Out-of-canvas membership clips; holes/attributes/width survive according to those literal transforms. Do not vectorize or fill holes.
geometry_contract_proposal.empty_masks: Empty native masks remain valid transport/ROI values. They have no interactive bounds/handles; unchanged numeric transforms are no-ops. Do not infer emptiness from signed polygon area or weaken existing self-intersecting area validation.
geometry_contract_proposal.preview: SelectionEditor stages only a private row draft; invalid calculations clear the current gesture preview rather than retaining a publishable last-valid candidate. Metadata/row/capture admission precedes bounded copies and any callbacks.

position_and_guard_proposal.positions: Native optional absent/nullopt and V3 null mean wildcard independently per axis; integer0 is a real constraint. V3 requires its canonical t/c/z keys. Do not infer native T/C from legacy rank or treat missing/native wildcard as zero. Legacy ROI/ZIP migration is separate work.
fresh_capture: owner identity/membership and active-owner activation token
source shape and exact original row
XY pointer-to-image transform/metric for physical gestures
position_and_guard_proposal.fresh_commit: The final native controller lane must atomically require membership/active activation, Data revisions, row equality and captured TCZ, then commit the exact saved-row transaction. A separate Window check followed by unguarded Application.commit is insufficient for concurrent navigation/away-back. Reuse the existing transient activation identity pattern; add no Document revision or serialized epoch.
position_and_guard_proposal.display_policy: Numeric Apply preserves fresh cameras and unrelated Display properties. For physical drags, changing zoom/pan/view transform cancels the gesture rather than reinterpreting its old pointer transform. TCZ navigation, owner switch/away-back, close, busy processing and tool change cancel/invalidates drafts; a foreign same-numeric-ID identity refuses.
position_and_guard_proposal.publication_admission: No source read or callback is needed for metadata-only admission. Geometry/mask cancellation may use existing ExecutionControl; all allocating record/output/history staging is before mutation and no user callback separates final guard and commit.

revision_history_dirty_proposal.private_preview: No native revision, workflow append, history/redo, dirty state, source pixel or global-selection mutation.
revision_history_dirty_proposal.explicit_global_selection_action: If separately selecting a saved row into the global current selection, retain native select() semantics: Selection+1 only when changed and previous_selection captured once, no metadata/pixel history or dirty identity. This is distinct from Edit Saved Area.
revision_history_dirty_proposal.accepted_saved_geometry: set_rois replaces only targeted row.selection; retain row name/t/c/z/attributes and every other row. Preserve native current selection and previous_selection, pixels, calibration, metadata unrelated to ROI collection, overlays, spectra and full display. A changed row causes Metadata+1 and Selection+1, one undo entry/redo clear/dirty identity advance, with Pixels and Display unchanged.
revision_history_dirty_proposal.noop: If the complete replacement selection equals the captured row selection, call no transaction/publication and append no workflow event. Pointer down/up or numeric Apply alone is not a dirty edit.
revision_history_dirty_proposal.undo_redo: Use existing native history to restore row geometry and complete data identity. No second select() edit is introduced by focus refresh. Old edit captures are stale after undo/redo.
revision_history_dirty_proposal.failure: Invalid geometry/limits/callback/cancel/stale/foreign/closed/admission failure changes no native data, display, workflow or history. Clear invalid private drafts/target tokens; preserve manager focus only if its fresh row token still validates. Stage accepted focus/output changes before commit and finish without allocation afterward.

linked_redraw_contract.required: After committed edit and undo/redo, observe a new frame from the current committed data generation in linked XY/XZ/YZ. XY saved-row outline reflects the committed/restored geometry and position matching. XZ/YZ sampled pixels, calibration, crosshair and channel-display mapping remain exact because this action edits no pixels.
linked_redraw_contract.cache: Reuse existing revision/position-based renderer invalidation. Current-generation acknowledgement and correct frames are required; do not force a texture cache miss if immutable pixel reuse is valid.
linked_redraw_contract.separate_required_work: Read-only positioned-ROI projections into XZ/YZ and editing from XZ/YZ remain required follow-ons. Do not draw unprojected XY coordinates on those panes, add a projection prerequisite to the first XY exit, or claim this exit covers either feature.

minimal_native_and_frontend_seams.change: A small immutable saved-row replacement command: typed request {row_index, replacement Selection}, source/row/position descriptor, bounded estimate, strict typed Metadata record, resolve/validate/from_record/full_rebind/prepare factories. Existing SelectionEditor composes drafts; do not serialize a command on each pointer frame or add public JSON dependencies.

One atomic active-owner/activation/TCZ guarded publication adapter for the prepared set_rois edit. Reuse DocumentTransaction and existing activation token, with callbacks outside locks. Standalone core/SDK preparation remains usable without a desktop.

A saved-row target overload/adapter for existing SelectionPanel and ordinary/linked XY gesture mapping, with row-derived geometry instead of source.data.selection. Add only narrow scientific capability admission for this explicit target; preserve generic guards.
Reuse owner/Metadata/index row tokens; explicit focus/reselection invalidation and position-aware Edit Saved Area admission. No durable-ID/schema project or whole-manager rewrite.

Thin request/immutable command/record/prepare/publication wrappers. Capture mutable values before GIL release; reject bool/lossy/overflow integer row indices and limits; return detached mutable getters. No geometry arithmetic in Python.

record_replay_rebind_proposal.action: replace_saved_roi_geometry; proposed separate version1 command schema, with exact field allowlists to freeze at adoption. Preserve all existing command/session versions.
record_contents: complete source identity/shape/type/policy and Pixels/Metadata provenance
original row index and complete original Roi including optional positions/attributes
captured TCZ and global Selection provenance (provenance, not an unrelated edit target)
complete replacement Selection plus unchanged row metadata claims
record_replay_rebind_proposal.original_validation: Bound/decode every field/geometry/mask/metadata subtree before destination lookup or replacement casting. This is a complete replacement action, not an authenticated pointer history; validate exact original/result row fields and allowed selection replacement rather than inventing a drag-equation proof.
record_replay_rebind_proposal.strict_replay: Bind original owner plus Pixels/Metadata and exact original row; publish the stored replacement without image reads or recomputing against the current global selection. Preserve current navigation/cameras/global selection. Because a saved-row write advances Metadata, replay of an already-applied historical command can correctly refuse as stale; do not silently rebind.
record_replay_rebind_proposal.full_rebind: Validate the whole old record first; require an explicit new row_index and complete replacement Selection against the destination snapshot. Recompute admission/record from the new owner/row/positions; borrow no old row index, saved position or result implicitly.
record_replay_rebind_proposal.recording: Stage exactly one normalized native event for a changed accepted edit when recording is on; recording off changes only append policy. Failure/cancel/noop append none. Add exact workflow dispatch for this schema in both launch modes; do not masquerade as a legacy unpositioned edit.
record_replay_rebind_proposal.native_v3: Roundtrip complete saved Roi and workflow through existing native V3, including zero/null positions, masks, attributes/styles and global selections. Reopen uses fresh owners, clean history and no live binding/replay/rebind; detached legacy JSON/V2 guards remain unchanged.

bounded_entry_matrix_proposal.membership_state: Proposed fixtures and case allocation, not frozen collection or executed gates. Freeze exact IDs/inputs/independent oracles once before implementation.

Getter/frontend copies, provider caches, renderer/GPU and total process RSS are separately measured, not covered by this native working cap.
